user.t:
Build the MVP for a new venture and push it to a NEW PRIVATE GitHub repo. Follow the proven pattern of C:\Users\mariu\ventures\freight-recovery — READ it first for structure/stack/style/honesty, then build an equivalent MVP for THIS domain.

DOMAIN: Customs / tariff classification review + post-entry duty audit & recovery. The problem: importers overpay duties through wrong HTS classification, missed free-trade-agreement/duty-drawback eligibility, and valuation errors; post-entry audits recover overpaid duty. MVP: ingest entry/commercial-invoice data (CSV + PDF entry summaries), extract line items (part, description, declared HTS, value, duty paid, country of origin), apply AUDIT RULES (flag HTS inconsistencies vs description keywords using a small bundled PUBLIC HTS subset, recompute duty = value x rate, flag over/underpayment, missing FTA/origin claims, valuation anomalies), and produce an EVIDENCE PACKET + DRAFT post-entry adjustment / recovery line outputs marked DRAFT / DO-NOT-FILE.

Repo/naming: repo `customs-duty-recovery` (private, under socrates6969), package `customs_recovery`, env prefix `CDR_`, API-key prefix `cdk_`.

STACK + STRUCTURE (match freight): FastAPI, pydantic v2, uvicorn, python-multipart, pdfplumber, pytest, httpx; stdlib csv + Decimal for money (NO pandas). `src/customs_recovery/{ingest,extract,rules,evidence,api}` MVP phase only (auth/db/sandbox/storage foundation LATER). Deterministic OFFLINE extraction + placeholder LLM provider raising NotImplementedError (no network). Real duty math with Decimal + invariants + edge cases. Tests. README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, hash-locked requirements. Business docs: business/business-plan.md + market-analysis.md, financial/model.md, fundraising/README.md (firm-level official channels only, no dossiers), hiring/README.md (role specs + Norway sourcing).

HONEST: pre-product, synthetic fixtures, no fabricated metrics, DRAFT outputs. The bundled HTS/rates are an illustrative SUBSET — flag that real classification/filing needs a licensed customs broker and current CBP/HTS data. NO "ruflo"/"ruvnet" names. Keep tests green.

Create the private repo via `gh repo create socrates6969/customs-duty-recovery --private --source . --remote origin`, commit in logical chunks, push. End each commit message with:
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <[REDACTED:email]>
Return a concise summary (repo URL, test count, stubbed/deferred).

handback.t:
The MVP is built and pushed to a new private repo. It follows the freight-recovery pattern (FastAPI, pydantic v2, stdlib csv and Decimal, no pandas). The suite passes locally (214 tests) and the first GitHub Actions run on `main` is green.

**Repo:** https://github.com/socrates6969/customs-duty-recovery (private, `main`). It was created with `gh repo create ... --private --source . --remote origin`, and the commit history is in 9 logical commits. Every commit message ends with the `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8` line.

**Tests:** `pytest` gives **214 passed** locally on Windows with Python 3.14.7. They run offline, and one test asserts the pipeline opens no sockets. The first GitHub Actions run on `main` (run 37267235590) had all four jobs green: tests on Python 3.12, `pip-audit`, a `trivy` repository scan, and the image build with `trivy` image scan and a container smoke test. The smoke test checks health, a full audit of the demo entry, and the `DRAFT / DO-NOT-FILE` marker. The Docker image was not built locally because the Docker daemon was unavailable.

**What the pipeline does:**
- Ingests CSV, TXT and text-layer PDF entry data, extracts lines with an offline deterministic stub, runs the audit rules, and writes an evidence packet.
- Rules recompute duty per line as value x rate with `Decimal` (half-up to the cent). They cover description-vs-HTS mismatch against a bundled 27-code subset, missed or unsupported FTA claims, unit-value outliers, duplicate lines, header-total mismatch and drawback candidates.
- The packet carries `DRAFT / DO-NOT-FILE` in its header, footer, JSON status and every adjustment line. Draft lines list an indicative filing route, prerequisites, heuristic timing and exposure notes.
- The API is `GET /health`, `POST /v1/audit`, `POST /v1/audit/text` and `GET /v1/hts[/code]`, plus a CLI. The `CDR_` environment prefix is in use, and `cdk_` exists only as a reserved constant.
- Supporting files: README, ARCHITECTURE, Dockerfile, docker-compose, CI, dependabot, and hash-locked requirements generated with `uv pip compile`.
- Business docs: `business/business-plan.md`, `business/market-analysis.md`, `financial/model.md`, `fundraising/README.md` (firm-level official channels only) and `hiring/README.md` (role specs and Norway sourcing).

**Honesty choices:**
- The bundled HTS subset, rates and FTA treatment are labeled illustrative and unverified, not current tariff data, and real classification and filing are said to need a licensed customs broker and current CBP/USITC HTS data.
- Findings are bucketed and never merged: confirmed-vs-table overpaid, review overpaid, underpaid exposure, and a separate drawback bucket. "Confirmed" only means arithmetic against the illustrative table.
- Overlapping review rules on one line are capped, so confirmed plus review overpaid never exceeds duty paid (checked by a seeded randomized test).
- No overpayment rate or market size is invented. Financial figures are all labeled assumptions, and the $1B figure is shown only as a "what would have to be true" calculation. Statutory references (19 USC 1514, 1520(d), 1313, 1592, 1641) are from general knowledge and flagged for counsel to confirm.
- There is no "ruflo" or "ruvnet" anywhere in the repo.

**Stubbed or deferred:**
- `LLMExtractionProvider` is a placeholder that raises `NotImplementedError` and makes no network call.
- Auth and tenancy (`cdk_` keys), database and migrations, sandboxed parsing worker, object storage and deployment are not built; the API has no authentication and is documented as loopback-only.
- Not built: real CBP Form 7501 / ACE report parsing, OCR for scanned PDFs, the full USITC HTS, Chapter 99 additional duties, AD/CVD, MPF/HMF, specific or compound rates, and real rules-of-origin checks.
- Not built: a rulings-based evaluation set (CBP CROSS), ACE liquidation-status integration, and an external security audit.
- Filing-route timing is heuristic, about 314 days from entry to liquidation when no liquidation date is given.
- The fundraising and market-analysis docs were written without live web research, so firm theses and competitor characterisations are grade C and unverified.
